boundary: Unverified restriction stays needs-review; unresolved applicable nonwaivable issue cannot support positive acceptance.

evidence: Entity type and legally required framework; approved product scope
boundary: Full IFRS/SME/IPSAS/specialist topics have separate applicability; no automatic expansion.

evidence: Original bytes/hashes and visible content or attributable accepted variant decision
boundary: Preserve registered/current histories; unsupported source inference cannot close fidelity.

evidence: Original requirements and approved offering + full standards/method assumptions
boundary: Manual judgment may be supported; required promised numerical automation cannot silently become manual.

evidence: Applicable full standard clauses, client policy elections and professional approval
boundary: No default life/rate/confidence/netting/rounding choice masquerades as standard law.

decision: Mandatory native exports and accepted layout variance
evidence: Original output requirements, actual use and auditor approval
boundary: HTML alone cannot replace mandatory XLSX/DOCX parity without explicit accepted variance.

evidence: Expert appointment, confidentiality basis and selected document-set authority
boundary: Full access means selected engagement scope, never firm-wide automatic authority.

evidence: Primary law, applicable professional rule and operating storage/backup contract
boundary: No silent expiry deletion; unverified deadlines and residual copies remain explicit.

decision: Audit-facing B scope and optional C offerings
evidence: Every original B/C obligation with audit necessity and authorized offering disposition
boundary: Do not defer audit quality/later-fact duties with broader firm ERP.

evidence: Approved workload/security/recovery goals and designated integration/operating owners
boundary: Local demonstrations do not establish external effects or production readiness.

decision: Named research and independent review capacity
evidence: Actual named people and authority, available effort and domain competence
boundary: Role suggestions are not assignments; no sprint dates/estimates before source triage.
